members.name: Chris Cox
members.title: Lead Child & Youth Program Coordinator
members.bio: Chris Cox leads the Iowa Army National Guard Child & Youth Program. A proud Guard kid himself, he’s passionate about cheering on today’s Guard youth and ensuring every family feels supported, connected, and seen. Alongside Erin, he plans statewide programs that strengthen readiness and resilience across Iowa’s military community.

members.name: Erin Coogler
members.title: Child & Youth Program Coordinator
members.bio: Erin Coogler helps lead the Iowa Army National Guard Child & Youth Program with heart and purpose. She’s known for her creativity, organization, and deep care for military-connected families. Partnering with Chris, she plans events and initiatives that build connection, confidence, and community for Guard youth across Iowa.
